name: apple-m5-ultra-64c
nominal_note: [S] 1.2 TB/s for the M5 Ultra (1024-bit LPDDR5X-9600, twice the M5 Max's 614.4)
note: Measured on a 64-core, 96 GB M5 Ultra (Mac Studio Mac17,15, macOS 27.0.1) by tools/profile_writer.py and the probe suite; the 80-core M5 Ultra is a different device. No fusion recipes or kernel choices yet.

engine.note: written by tools/profile_writer.py from the kernel harnesses (min-of-N over >= 2 GB streamed per point): cost_T = the pass cost relative to a T = 1 shader pass at the best geometry per T; accelerator_<fmt> = gemm_tile at TM rows in the same unit; sibling_order and max_cb_ms are the probes' (p11, p6/p6b) and attention_rows the file's: they carry over; sibling_order measured by p12 on this Ultra (ALU-first hides 88 % of the smaller ALU sibling inside a saturating bus op, bus-first 13 %); max_cb_ms keeps the default: p6b's 15 ms buffers held a second queue's worst wait to 7.6 ms and p15 saw no late frames at 8-133 ms buffers

hosts_target_model_note: 21 GB of weights against recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize 77.76 GB, maxBufferLength 58.32 GB

decisions.lane_order: pinned to interleaved16 (--lane-order); the T = 1 point measured interleaved16 699 GB/s, contiguous 716 GB/s; the writer's first run took contiguous at that point (747 vs 682 GB/s), within the spread: two paired alternating A/B runs (4 rounds each; the T = 1 shader at every writer geometry and the TM = 8 tile on 17408x5120, 5120x17408 and 248320x5120) have interleaved16 faster on every BF16 point, the FP8 tile, the FP8 shader on 17408x5120 and 248320x5120 and the NVFP4/INT4 shader on 17408x5120 (1.36x), contiguous on the K = 17408 shader points (FP8 0.93x, NVFP4/INT4 0.69-0.70x) and the NVFP4 17408x5120 tile (0.84-0.86x); the NVFP4 MLP (gate + up + down) 3 % faster contiguous at T = 1 and 8 % on the tile, the FP8 tile 3-24 % faster interleaved16: a tie on the target, so the writer's tie rule and the Apple10 default stand; p12 streams lane-interleaved 16-byte words at 1150-1164 GB/s against 850-1072 lane-contiguous
decisions.scale_placement: block streams 1.078x inline (the unit's padding gone)
decisions.threadgroups_per_core: a tie (x1 0.115 ms, x2 0.113 ms): keeps 1
decisions.accelerator: nvfp4: the tile from T = 2 (tile TM8 1.34, TM16 1.27, TM32 2.39 vs shader T2 2.17, T4 3.50, T8 9.44); fp8: the tile from T = 4 (tile TM8 1.20, TM16 1.16, TM32 1.84 vs shader T2 1.07, T4 2.70, T8 4.19); int4_affine: the tile from T = 2 (tile TM8 1.57, TM16 1.58, TM32 2.11 vs shader T2 2.47, T4 4.03, T8 11.26); bf16: the tile from T = 4 (tile TM8 1.14, TM16 1.05, TM32 1.19 vs shader T2 1.08, T4 1.16, T8 3.44)
